title: Family Pixar, Harry Potter & Dinosaur Adventure in London
summary: A 2-day London itinerary for a family of four with kids aged 7 and 11 who love Pixar movies, Harry Potter books, Minecraft and dinosaurs. The trip blends kid-friendly museums, landmarks and parks with halal meals and prayer stops at nearby mosques, keeping walking distances short and each day focused on a different area.

days.theme: South Kensington museums and Hyde Park

stops.why: Natural History Museum showcases animatronic dinosaurs and skeletons, perfect for kids who love dinosaurs.
stops.name: Natural History Museum
stops.address: Cromwell Rd South Kensington, London SW7 5BD United Kingdom
stops.description: Landmark South Kensington museum showcasing the natural world with hands-on exhibits, animatronic dinosaurs, extensive scientific collections, and active research programs.

stops.why: Hyde Park offers open space for boating and playing, ideal for children to burn energy after museum visits.
stops.name: Hyde Park
stops.description: Huge central London park featuring the Serpentine lake, boating, swimming, the Diana Memorial Fountain, Speaker’s Corner and large event spaces.

stops.why: Dhuhr at the mosque nearest to Hyde Park.
stops.name: Mayfair Islamic Centre
stops.address: 19 Hertford St London W1J 7RU United Kingdom
stops.description: Central London mosque offering daily prayers, Islamic classes, a Friday post-khutbah library, community services, marriage/divorce validation, and visitor support.

stops.why: EL&N is a verified halal coffee shop offering light lunch options near the museum area.
stops.name: EL&N

stops.why: Islamic Centre hosts Asr prayer, allowing the family to pray without traveling far from Hyde Park.
stops.name: Islamic Centre
stops.address: 10 Berwick St London W1F 0PH United Kingdom
stops.description: Central London mosque and cultural centre offering daily prayers and two Jumu'ah services; often male-only and with restricted opening outside adhan times.

stops.why: The National Gallery displays Western European masterpieces, offering a cultural break suitable for older kids.
stops.name: The National Gallery
stops.address: Trafalgar Square London WC2N 5DN United Kingdom
stops.description: Trafalgar Square museum displaying masterworks that trace the development of Western European painting.

stops.why: Islamic Centre is nearby for Maghrib prayer after a day of museum and park exploration.
stops.name: Islamic Centre
stops.address: 10 Berwick St London W1F 0PH United Kingdom
stops.description: Central London mosque and cultural centre offering daily prayers and two Jumu'ah services; often male-only and with restricted opening outside adhan times.

stops.why: BKC Biryani Kebab Chai serves verified halal Indian cuisine, ideal for a family dinner near South Kensington.
stops.name: BKC Biryani Kebab Chai

days.theme: City landmarks and Harry Potter sites

stops.why: Known for Harry Potter, which you said you love. Ornate Victorian covered market in the City of London, offering boutique shops, cafés, restaurants and historic…
stops.name: Leadenhall Market
stops.address: Gracechurch St London EC3V 1LT United Kingdom
stops.description: Ornate Victorian covered market in the City of London, offering boutique shops, cafés, restaurants and historic 14th-century architecture.

stops.why: Shrek's Adventure London provides an immersive, family-friendly walkthrough based on DreamWorks films, appealing to kids who enjoy animated stories like Pixar.
stops.name: Shrek's Adventure London
stops.address: Riverside Building County Hall, Westminster Bridge Rd London SE1 7PB United Kingdom
stops.description: Immersive, family-friendly walkthrough based on the DreamWorks film, featuring a 4D flying bus, interactive fairy-tale shows, sensory effects, and character encounters.

stops.why: Islamic Centre offers Dhuhr prayer within a short distance of the City area landmarks.
stops.name: Islamic Centre
stops.address: 10 Berwick St London W1F 0PH United Kingdom
stops.description: Central London mosque and cultural centre offering daily prayers and two Jumu'ah services; often male-only and with restricted opening outside adhan times.

stops.why: CERU Farringdon is a verified halal Mediterranean restaurant suitable for lunch near Leadenhall Market.
stops.name: CERU Farringdon

stops.why: Asr at the mosque nearest to CERU Farringdon.
stops.name: Holborn Mosque
stops.address: Brookes Court 33 Baldwin's Gardens London EC1N 7RR United Kingdom
stops.description: Central London mosque and community centre offering daily prayers, outreach, and welfare services in a converted building near Baldwin's Gardens.

stops.why: Monument to the Great Fire of London offers panoramic city views after climbing its 311 steps, fun for active kids.
stops.name: Monument to the Great Fire of London
stops.address: Fish St Hill London EC3R 8AH United Kingdom
stops.description: Tall 202-foot fluted Doric column with viewing platform commemorating the Great Fire of London, offering panoramic city views after climbing 311 steps.

stops.why: Maghrib at the mosque nearest to Monument to the Great Fire of London.
stops.name: Baitul Aziz Islamic Cultural Centre
stops.address: 1 Dickens Square London SE1 4JL United Kingdom
stops.description: Established community mosque in Elephant & Castle offering spacious prayer halls and regular Jummah and Tarāwīḥ services near Dickens Square.

stops.why: Puttshack is a verified halal venue offering games and dining, providing a fun dinner experience for the family.
stops.name: Puttshack

tips: Use contactless payment for London transport; kids under 11 travel free on buses and trams.
Check mosque websites for any changes in prayer timings or women's facilities before visiting.
Carry a reusable water bottle and snacks for the kids during museum visits to avoid long queues at cafes.
